headline: Equinix Partners with Central Georgia Electric Membership Corporation to Protect Ratepayers
summary: Equinix, Inc. (Nasdaq: EQIX), the world's digital infrastructure company® and regional, not-for-profit utility cooperative Central Georgia Electric Membership Corporation (CGEMC) announced a new partnership to protect Hampton, Ga. ratepayers and surrounding communities.
